sources.title: LFM2.5-VL-3B: Liquid's Faster Edge Vision-Language Model
sources.snippet: Liquid AI released LFM2.5-VL-3B (~Aug 12, 2026): a ~3.1B open-weight vision-language model for edge / on-device use. It is a non-reasoning VL (answers directly for lower latency), with big jumps vs prior LFM2-VL-3B on screen/UI understanding, grounding, function calling, and multi-image input.
